claims.text: Opinion-based prompts reframe the context as a narrator's statement and inquire about the narrator's opinions.
Counterfactual demonstrations use instances containing false facts to improve faithfulness in knowledge conflict situations.
Neither opinion-based prompts nor counterfactual demonstrations require additional training.

evidence.description: Opinion-based prompts reframe the context as a narrator's statement and inquire about the narrator's opinions
counterfactual demonstrations use instances containing false facts to improve faithfulness in knowledge conflict situations

methodologies.name: Context-faithful Prompting
methodologies.description: A set of prompting techniques including opinion-based prompts and counterfactual demonstrations to enhance LLMs' contextual faithfulness without training.

limitations.text: Reliance on parametric knowledge may cause LLMs to overlook contextual cues, leading to incorrect predictions in context-sensitive NLP tasks.
